t1.description: Create package.json (ESM module, Node >=22, scripts: start, build, test; no runtime dependencies) and src/convert.js containing the pure temperature conversion and validation logic. convert.js exports convert(value, from, to) returning {value, unit} and validate(payload) returning {value,from,to} or throwing an error with a nonempty message. Implements FR3 formulas, same-unit preservation, and FR4 validation (missing fields, nonnumeric, booleans, unsupported units, below absolute zero at C=-273.15, F=-459.67, K=0 with floating-point tolerance).
t1.meaning: candidate integrated; run validation still required

t2.description: Create src/app.js exposing an HTTP handler/router (createApp) with GET / serving public/index.html, POST /api/convert parsing JSON, calling validate+convert and returning 200 {value,unit} or 400 {error} (malformed JSON included), and GET /health returning 200 {status:'ok'}. Also create src/server.js that starts the server on process.env.PORT (default 3000).
t2.meaning: candidate integrated; run validation still required

t3.description: Create public/index.html with a numeric input, source and destination unit selectors (C/F/K), submit button, result display, and a visible error feedback element. Client-side JS POSTs to /api/convert, renders the returned {value, unit}, and shows the {error} string on 400.
t3.meaning: candidate integrated; run validation still required

t4.description: Create real unit tests using node:test (no external test runner). test/convert.test.js tests conversion formulas, same-unit preservation, and all validation rejections (missing/nonnumeric/boolean/unsupported units/absolute zero boundaries/tolerance). test/app.test.js tests HTTP routes via the exported router/handler without a listening server: /health 200, /api/convert 200 and 400 cases, malformed JSON 400, and GET / 200.
t4.meaning: candidate integrated; run validation still required

t5.description: Create README.md documenting install (npm install), start (npm start, PORT default 3000), test (npm test), build (npm run build = node --check syntax validation), API contract, limitations (no external services, single process), and a source-to-code/test traceability table mapping FR1-FR5 and NFR1-NFR2 to the implementing files.
t5.meaning: candidate integrated; run validation still required
